# Intersection constructor witness

An owned non-generic class declares a constructor with its own `<T extends Bound & Flag>` formal and a separate two-argument overload. Allocation sites use a concrete argument or an inherited `this` witness. A nested allocation and immutable external generic caller retain the original object, constructor selection and callee check.

Source and frozen dependency layouts compile every emitted unit and compare every original class, method, Code role, Signature, Exceptions and exact helper. The independent observer runs direct, reflective, method-handle, nested, external generic and constructor calls in fresh JVMs, with cold and warm initialization, future overrides, nulls, partial writes and exact checked/runtime/Error identities. Wrong programs qualify the observer. Same-Code Signature and missing-witness controls must reject, with the original missing-witness program independently demonstrating that class initialization precedes the callee cast.
